About

I'm a Business Information Systems graduate who likes to learn by doing. While studying, I earned 14 certificates across marketing, entrepreneurship, finance, and programming, trained twice at PharmaOverseas, worked in real estate sales and co-founded a real estate company, and built the whole front-end of my graduation project. Today I co-run The Social Club, a marketing agency, where I bring all three sides together: I plan the marketing, I understand the sale, and I can build the website behind it.
